Reference / crypto/nonce

crypto/nonce#

Entropy is the explicit randomness capability of crypto/*: keys, salts, nonces and randomized signatures draw from the Entropy they are given and never from ambient state.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let entropy = SystemEntropy();
let nonce = RandomNonce(entropy, 12).bytes();

Description#

Entropy is the explicit randomness capability of crypto/*: keys, salts, nonces and randomized signatures draw from the Entropy they are given and never from ambient state. SystemEntropy is the host CSPRNG (getrandom). Entropy.fake() is a deterministic test source, never secure.

RandomNonce draws size fresh bytes on every bytes() call (1..1024). CounterNonce is the deterministic AEAD nonce prefix || big-endian counter, exactly size bytes; the counter must fit the remaining width. The caller owns counter uniqueness per key: a repeated (key, nonce) pair breaks AEAD.
